episode_id: Upstream changed something about its branches and my checkout is lost. Sort it out. Track upstream's new branch and merge it into my own commits./seed-2-branch_renamed-7516

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (branch_renamed seed 1 resolves to 'merge', which accepts ['merge']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'retrack', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'merge' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.intent: Re-point the current local branch to upstream's renamed default branch and merge it into the local commits.

postconditions.description: the current branch is configured to track the new upstream branch
postconditions.name: current_branch_tracks_new_upstream

postconditions.description: the new upstream branch is an ancestor of HEAD
postconditions.name: new_upstream_is_ancestor

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit with at least two parents
postconditions.name: head_is_merge_commit

postconditions.description: the first parent still has local commits not in upstream
postconditions.name: local_first_parent_preserved

postconditions.description: the index has no unmerged entries
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_entries

postconditions.description: there are no uncommitted changes to tracked files after the merge
postconditions.name: tracked_files_clean_after_merge

preconditions.description: the remote-tracking ref for upstream's new branch exists
preconditions.name: new_upstream_ref_exists

preconditions.description: the current branch has at least one commit not reachable from the new upstream branch
preconditions.name: current_branch_has_local_commits

preconditions.description: the new upstream branch has at least one commit not in the current branch
preconditions.name: new_upstream_has_commits_to_merge

preconditions.description: the current branch tracks a different branch on the same remote
preconditions.name: current_branch_tracks_other_branch_on_same_remote
preconditions.probe:
ref=$(git for-each-ref --format='%(upstream:short)' "refs/heads/$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD)")
test -n "$ref" && test "$ref" != "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" && test "${ref%%/*}" = "{upstream_remote}"

preconditions.description: there are no uncommitted changes to tracked files
preconditions.name: tracked_files_clean
